source: Union of the ad-spec safe zones for 1080x1920: TikTok (top 240px, bottom 660px, sides 120px, button column 300px from the right edge below y=840), Instagram Reels (14% top, 35% bottom, 6% sides), YouTube Shorts (10% top, 25% bottom, 10% right). TikTok figures are the in-feed template scaled from 720x1280. These are AD zones, no platform publishes organic numbers: verify on a real phone with a private test post.
note: 2026-10-01: the working bottom limit moved from 416 (ad-spec union) to 470 so the layout can use the whole frame. 470 is an ESTIMATE for organic posts (Shorts ad spec is 480). Amber = beyond the strict ad spec but inside our limit; red = beyond our limit. The phone test decides.
